panels.bt: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
panels.tx: Harry discovers that he belongs to a magical community, and friendship gives him a home at Hogwarts. When an old danger resurfaces, courage and trust matter more than fame.

panels.bt: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets
panels.tx: A season of fear at Hogwarts forces Harry to question where he belongs. A hidden history connects a present threat to Voldemort's past, and loyalty helps Harry protect a friend.

panels.bt: Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban
panels.tx: A prisoner escapes, and Harry learns that the story he was told about his parents is incomplete. New knowledge about friendship, betrayal and family changes whom he trusts and what justice means.

panels.bt: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire
panels.tx: A school tournament draws Harry into a larger conflict. Competition, public attention and a devastating loss mark the end of childhood certainty as Voldemort returns to power.

panels.bt: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix
panels.tx: As authorities deny the danger, Harry faces isolation and grief. Students build a secret community to learn and protect one another, while a vision pulls Harry toward a painful confrontation.

panels.bt: Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince
panels.tx: Harry and Dumbledore investigate the choices that made Voldemort powerful. The search reveals a way to weaken him, while fear and divided loyalties close in around Hogwarts.

panels.bt: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows
panels.tx: Away from school, Harry, Ron and Hermione pursue the remaining pieces of Voldemort's power. Their journey tests friendship and sacrifice; the final conflict turns on the choices people make when fear offers an easier path.
